recordability_test: Evaluate work relationship from actual supervision and control, not badge label alone.
An injury is work-related when an event in the host-controlled work environment caused or contributed to it.
Surgery and a fracture meet the serious-treatment criteria for the injury log.
rapid_reporting_test: A work-related inpatient hospitalization must be reported within 24 hours after the company learns of the hospitalization.
The deadline is calculated from the company knowledge time in the site timezone.
